parallel.requirements: The parent recognized the required Rust 2021, std-only, black-box port with argv[1] handling, thirteen printed transforms, Cargo structure, and root test13.rs deliverable.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent owned the main implementation and also spawned a probe_binary child; the child acted as an independent probe/implementation worker rather than an isolated read-only verifier.
parallel.implementation: The parent probed sample, delimiter, ASCII, empty, and non-ASCII behavior, wrote modules under src/inflection plus test13.rs, then repaired module wiring after child shared-tree writes changed the root entrypoint layout.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent ultimately delivered Cargo.toml, src/lib.rs, src/inflection modules, root test13.rs, /output/test13, and release artifacts after deleting stray top-level child files.
parallel.verification: The parent built with Cargo and rustc, compared a broad input set and no-argument invocation against the reference executable, and official evaluation passed all 39 testcases.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: No final task behavior remained incorrect, but the child result did not return to the parent and the parent had to repair a temporary shared-workspace overwrite.

serial.requirements: The serial run recognized the same Rust 2021, std-only, byte-identical output, argv[1], Cargo structure, root test13.rs, and black-box restrictions.
serial.plan_and_ownership: One actor owned probing, implementation, integration, verification, and final delivery without delegation or shared ownership boundaries.
serial.implementation: The serial agent probed the executable, wrote a Cargo project with src/inflection/ascii.rs and inflector.rs, detected the empty-string pluralize mismatch, and patched it.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial run kept a single implementation tree and produced /output/test13.rs, /output/test13, and /output/target/release/test13 without cross-agent reconciliation.
serial.verification: It rebuilt after the empty-string patch, compared a broad argument set and no-argument case against the reference, checked the standalone executable, and official evaluation passed all 39 testcases.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No final task behavior remained incorrect; the only observed defect was the ordinary empty-string bug that was found and fixed before closure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the exact CLI, output matching, std-only, Cargo, root test13.rs, and black-box executable-probing requirements.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same requirements and explicitly modeled ASCII-only transforms, literal pluralization, and no-argument behavior.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material final requirement coverage difference; both passed, though parallel also had to resolve coordination artifacts.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split work between parent and probe child, but both wrote implementation artifacts in /output rather than keeping a read-only probe boundary.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept probing, implementation, integration, and verification under one local owner.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced a cross-agent ownership boundary over the same deliverable tree; serial had no cross-agent ownership risk.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had no visible plaintext child brief, but behavior shows the child independently implemented into /output with a different module layout and no protected namespace.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used one internal behavior model and one module interface, so there was no handoff or cross-agent interface to reconcile.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The meaningful interface difference was not a missing API contract between components but a shared deliverable namespace collision in parallel.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent wrote a modular implementation under src/inflection with ascii, case, and words modules, then fixed import wiring after child overwrite.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a smaller module set with ascii.rs and inflector.rs, then patched pluralize for the empty input edge case.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both final algorithms matched the reference; parallel's extra implementation divergence was caused by child writes, while serial's defect was an ordinary local edge-case fix.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The child internally reached an all-cases-matched result, but parent waits timed out and the parent interrupted the child before receiving that result.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial produced and consumed each local verification result directly, including the post-patch all-clear.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel lost a child verification handoff; serial had no result-return boundary.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child and parent wrote the same root deliverable/project files and different library layouts into the shared /output tree, forcing cleanup and repair.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had a single writer for the output project, so its later patch applied to its own implementation state.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a concrete shared-state overwrite episode; serial did not.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent performed Cargo and rustc builds and a broad byte-for-byte comparison after repairing shared-tree conflicts; official evaluation then passed all 39 tests.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial built, detected and fixed the empty-string mismatch, reran broad comparisons, checked the standalone executable, and officially passed all 39 tests.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both had strong final acceptance evidence; parallel duplicated verification because the child result was unavailable to the parent.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used 334.228 agent seconds, spawned one child, waited twice on it, interrupted it, then closed after extra cleanup and final checks.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used 251.503 agent seconds with no subagents and closed after one local repair and validation cycle.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent extra coordination time and cleanup effort, but neither run approached the 2399 second timeout and both closed successfully.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is not discordant: both completed current status evaluations passed 39 of 39 testcases. The serial path was cleaner and single-owner, while the parallel path absorbed a child-created shared-output overwrite and lost the child verification handoff before still producing a passing final artifact.
parallel_contributors: Parent and child both probed behavior and produced working implementations.
Parent repaired the shared-output overwrite and performed its own final comparisons before closure.
serial_contributors: Single actor owned probing, implementation, patching, validation, and delivery.
Serial detected the empty-string pluralize mismatch and fixed it before final verification.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial initially had an ordinary empty-string pluralization bug and patched it.
Parallel had an ordinary temporary module import breakage after cleanup, but that breakage was caused by cross-agent shared-file edits.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained patterns describe adverse parallel process costs only
